decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that mint #1 receives no commission when no existing holder is available.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint ticket exception and adjusts the expected visible total to exclude Mint #1.
The accepted exception concerns the already-completed first mint, and the client explicitly says it has no impact going forward; the prospective no-referral FAQ rule remains valid.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already updates commission reconciliation to exclude the one-off first mint that could not award a commission.
This Requirement governs Small Block tickets earned by referral-code mints; the source decision concerns only the no-referral allocation edge case for Mint #1.
The direct-referral commission remains payable when an existing holder's referral code is used; the no-referral first-mint exception does not alter it.
The feedback copy remains valid for future no-code or invalid-code mints because existing NFT holders are now available; the accepted exception was limited to Mint #1.
The source decision changes whether Mint #1 receives a ticket, not whether ticket counters and awarded rewards must be represented accurately in NFT metadata.
The condition that valid referral codes identify previously minted NFTs is unchanged by the no-referral first-mint exception.
The About-page process copy describes ongoing no-referral behavior, while the client accepted Mint #1 as a completed one-off with no future impact.
The first-mint ticket exception does not change the approved badge catalog, badge names, icons, or inclusion rules.
The accepted reward-allocation exception does not change when the mint-success modal appears, which token ID it shows, or its no-referral finalization control.
